limits: These eight are authored synthetic source boundaries, not new real projects, customer contracts or human user studies.
Exact source quotations establish provenance, not inferred page-role mapping, real runtime execution or the correctness of every normative conclusion.
The source truth reference for partial-owner-only is supported; unlike the controlled partial-selector fixture, this actual model answer chose full owners and correctly retained support.
Frozen references and both numeric disagreements remain unchanged; independent adjudication does not rewrite the measured results.
This review does not establish opponent superiority, award likelihood, browser behavior, user acceptance, payment or live production persistence.
